name: android_transfer_file
description: Copies a file: direction "push" (computer to device) or "pull" (device to computer), overwriting the destination without asking. direction "scan" indexes remotePath in MediaStore so media apps see a new file.

localPath.description: push/pull: absolute path on the computer.

remotePath.description: Absolute path on the device, e.g. /sdcard/Download/a.jpg.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
